closedDefect.defect: no normal product path constructed a Work Worker Port, and the install composed neither the execution-association concern nor a trajectory surface

workerCapability.hostDerivation: host/dsh/lib/index.js:deriveWorkWorkerFacts() reads its own DSH bin (process.argv[1] / PALIMPSEST_DSH_BIN) and --profile, exactly as deriveBranchHost does, and returns the FACTS
workerCapability.portConstruction: src/install.ts constructs dshSubprocessWorkWorkerPort from those facts
workerCapability.distinctFromBranch: the work worker port is derived independently of the reasoning bundle, so obtaining one does not require the branch capability
workerCapability.startsNothing: composing the port executes nothing: the gate measured 0 attempts after composition
workerCapability.absentIsHonest: no host facts means no port and no Work Delegation, never a stub

recorderComposition.boundary: src/composition/continuation.ts wires the recorder to the delegation service's onCorrelatedSessionIdentity and finalizes the window from onTerminal
recorderComposition.ownership: the recorder is attached at the Parent/Delegation boundary, so the worker or model never names its own AttemptId

storeOwnership.created: src/composition/execution_association.ts creates the SqliteExecutionAssociationStore beside the orchestration store
storeOwnership.lifetime: INSTALL_CREATED_AND_MANAGED, closed by the install lifecycle after the controller and the log
storeOwnership.callerOwned: a caller-supplied store is honored and not closed by the install

readerProductization.lazyMount: the reader mounts its Cordis persistence backend on first use, so the synchronous install pays nothing and a deployment that never reads a session mounts nothing
